content.title: Chapter 66 - PARKS AND RECREATION — Sec. 66-26. - Horses.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to ride, lead or otherwise permit any horse in
               or upon any public park, except for posted equestrian trails and posted equestrian
               centers.
(Code 1960, § 17-28; Code 1981, § 22-7; Ord. No. 3028, § 1, 12-13-1993)
